messages:
anya: Hey team — opened a small docs PR to add a compact example for the Console metrics widget that shows cost+latency rollup in one panel. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4512 :link: 
ben: looking now. the example is nice, but one of the links in the snippet points to the old tracehook page (404). can we patch to /docs/console/tracing/tracehook-v2? :eyes: 
anya: ah thanks — I must have missed that during copy. will update. also added a short Node+Python snippet showing how to attach trace keys to SDK calls.
claire: quick note — the Node snippet uses `trace_id` but our API expects `traceId` in the SDK helper. that's why the example can't be copy/pasted. small rename please.
anya: good catch. I can change to `traceId` and add a one-line note: "for older SDKs use `trace_id` mapping". keeps compatibility callout.
ben: also the dashboard YAML in the example uses `rollup: cost_latency` which is not an accepted preset. replace with `preset: cost-latency-v1` or show the minimal expression instead.
anya: will switch to `preset: cost-latency-v1` and drop the fake rollup. pushing a commit in a sec.
sam: re: tests — can we add a smokecheck in the PR description that lists the steps? e.g. 1) open Console -> Dashboards -> import example 2) confirm cost and p95 columns appear 3) click trace link and see tracehook page (should not 404). keeps reviewers from manually running through.
anya: good idea. adding a checklist to the PRdesc.
claire: small UX ask — can we shorten the code block and link to the full snippet file rather than embed 60 lines? long embeds make the page noisy.
anya: agree. I'll embed the 6-line minimal example and add a "Full example on GitHub" link to the raw snippet.
docs-bot: PR 4512 status: automerge blocked — lint errors in docs/snippets/console/metrics-compact.yaml (line 12). See CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference/4512/logs
ben: lint is from an extra trailing `,` in the YAML, easy fix.
anya: fixed and pushed (force-push). updated the traceId rename and link. requesting review from @claire and @ben. :pray:
claire: quick review now — looks much cleaner. One tiny wording nit in the note about "latency buckets" (suggest: "p50/p95 latency" instead).
sam: I ran import smoke locally — dashboard loads, widget shows cost + p95, trace links open the tracehook page. :tada: all good from my side.
ben: approved. :shipit:
anya: thanks! I'll merge once CI green. will also open a follow-up to add a short migration note for customers using the old `rollup` field to `preset` mapping.
docs-bot: PR 4512 merged by anya at 3571112343.
